node.title: Prepare work order
node.instructions: Read the project bridge, open the work order through xc-open-work-order, validate requested feature IDs without creating features, determine and validate work_order.document_language through xc-document from the explicit parameter or initiating user request, and record the requested scope. Write the report commitment work_order.requires_report in this same preparation step, resolved through the report policy rather than from the mode alone: an explicit user instruction first, then the project bridge which may only tighten, then report.default in the workshop configuration, then the built-in default. The shipped code-change-only tier means true for create, change, repair, and maintenance and false for investigation and review, and true when the mode cannot be confirmed, because an unknown mode is never interpreted as no report needed. Record work_order.report_skip_reason whenever the report is deliberately skipped, and capture work_order.report_baseline once, as the baseline commit, the worktree digest and the digest algorithm, and only when that resolved commitment is true: a work order that resolves to no report captures nothing, and the record keeps its three values and its publishable --format keys form. Where version control is unusable for the repository - it is not a worktree, or no baseline commit is resolvable - the capture fails closed and copies nothing; a full copy is admissible only through the explicit consent opt-in of the capture command, whose reference must name the user's explicit decision obtained through a main-session gate, and no new configuration item exists for it. The commitment, the initial report strength and, when the commitment is true, the baseline record are preparation-phase records, never retrospective notes, and a missing commitment fails this node.
node.deliverables: An authoritative workbench and explicit feature associations.
node.acceptance: The workbench is independent, feature associations are explicit, work_order.document_language is set before any document write, no unmanaged feature directory was created, and the mode-derived report commitment is written rather than assumed: work_order.requires_report carries the value the resolved report policy produced, every skip records one of the legal work_order.report_skip_reason values (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default), work_order.report_baseline records the baseline commit, the worktree digest and the digest algorithm only when the resolved commitment is true, a capture where version control was unusable failed closed with nothing copied unless the explicit consent opt-in of the capture command carried a reference naming the user's explicit decision, and a missing commitment fails this node.

node.title: Produce change review report
node.instructions: Produce the change report for this work order after verification and before the result document. The group is mounted by the commitment value work_order.requires_report. Embed the xc-change-report subtree once under this group, or run a single role=report node that carries the same contract. Resolve the subtree's template path from the committed setup record at .agents/.xcoding-setup/manifest.json, which holds the installed xc-change-report package's absolute path; change-report-template.xml is read from it, and the host-to-Skill-root table is the fallback for a project with no such record. Before the group's first node runs, publish all thirteen caller-seeded keys with the values this work order actually uses, never merely accepting their declared defaults: report.path, report.manifest_path, report.baseline_commit, report.baseline_digest, report.language, report.strength, report.gate_required, report.gate_outcome, report.gate_rework_required, report.gate_recovery_required, report.round, report.refresh_count, and report.refresh_reason. report.round is the 1-based index of the pass being entered. When prepare-manifest measures one or more analyzable units, produce the report; when it measures zero analyzable units, record work_order.report_skip_reason=zero_analyzable_units and produce no report; a user waiver records work_order.report_skip_reason=user_waived, and a skip the resolved report policy produced records work_order.report_skip_reason=policy_default. A skipped gate records report.gate_outcome=not-run, never accepted.
node.deliverables: On the produced outcome: one change-report.html, one change-report-manifest.json, and one change-report-verdicts.json under the workbench report node artifact directory. On the skipped outcome: no report file is required, and the deliverable is the recorded work_order.report_skip_reason with report.run_required=false.
node.acceptance: Exactly one of the two outcomes holds: either the report exists at report.path and is proven by report.manifest_path, or report.run_required is false and work_order.report_skip_reason records one of the legal reasons (read_only_mode, zero_analyzable_units, user_waived, policy_default); a produced report is never accepted without its manifest, and a skip is never accepted without its reason. The caller publishes all thirteen caller-seeded report.* keys with the values this work order uses before the group's first node runs, and the subtree's template is resolved from the installed package path the setup record holds, so the guards and completion-fact selectors the subtree evaluates resolve against those thirteen declarations or against a key one of the subtree's own nodes writes before that expression reads it.
